page_title: MAL 3-2 OSA | Mallorca v Osasuna 21/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+6' What a wasted opportunity by Ante Budimir (Osasuna)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Predrag Rajkovic makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
90+5' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+5' Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) sends a chip pass into the box, but Sergio Herrera is quickest to intercept the ball.
90+4' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
90+1' 3 - 2 Goal! Raul (Osasuna) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:2.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Daniel Rodriguez walks off.
90' It will be a substitution. Javier Llabres (Mallorca) is ready to enter the pitch as Antonio Sanchez walks off.
88' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Sergio Herrera thwarts him with a nice save.
85' Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul after Sergi Darder (Mallorca) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
84' Now Mallorca have a corner.
81' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Jon Moncayola and he is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jaume Costa leaves the pitch and Jose Copete (Mallorca) comes on.
79' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Jaume Costa (Mallorca) gets booked.
77' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
75' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 14:6.
74' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Predrag Rajkovic makes a comfortable save.
72' Raul (Osasuna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Predrag Rajkovic intercepts the ball.
71' Substitution. Manu Morlanes is replaced by Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
70' The substitution has been made. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) has replaced Cyle Larin.
66' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Pablo Ibanez is replaced by Chimy Avila (Osasuna).
66' The manager makes a subsitution with Raul (Osasuna) coming on for Jose Manuel Arnaiz.

65' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Predrag Rajkovic anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.

65' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Jaume Costa (Mallorca). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.

62' 3 - 1 It's in the back of the net – 3:1! Daniel Rodriguez took a perfect free kick, Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) managed to jump highest near the penalty spot and planted a long-range header into the top left corner.
61' A clumsy foul by Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Mallorca, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
60' The attendance for today's match is 14192.
59' A cross is whipped into the box by Jesus Areso (Osasuna) and Ante Budimir controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
56' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Ante Budimir (Osasuna), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
53' 2 - 1 Goal! Pablo Maffeo slips it to Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom left corner with a great effort. The score is 2:1.

50' A decent save by Sergio Herrera. Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
47' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
46' The game is over for Lucas Torro. Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) comes on for the second half.
46' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) comes on the pitch for Moi Gomez.
46' The whistle blows and Mario Melero Lopez starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is flagged for offside.

42' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
42' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) will take a corner kick.
41' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
40' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner but it's cleared.
39' The corner from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is intercepted by the defence.
38' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
33' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
32' Sergio Herrera pulls off a great save to deny Jaume Costa (Mallorca), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
29' Osasuna couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Predrag Rajkovic (Mallorca) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
28' What was Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
27' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
21' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Predrag Rajkovic.
19' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is able to continue to play.
17' Looks like Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
16' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

15' What a great touch by Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot towards the roof of the net, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Mallorca.

12' 1 - 1 Goal! Daniel Rodriguez launched the corner kick and superbly found the head of Matija Nastasic (Mallorca), whose accurate effort from near the penalty spot went straight into the bottom left corner. It's 1:1.
12' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is about to take a corner kick.
12' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Mallorca win a corner kick.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:1.

7' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the middle of the goal but is denied by Predrag Rajkovic, who pulls off a comfortable save!
6' Handball by Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca). Osasuna earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
5' Flag up against Cyle Larin (Mallorca). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
4' Some patient build-up play from Mallorca as they look to unlock the defence.
2' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
Mario Melero Lopez is the one to supervise the game today.
